geometry_status: assumed solver construction, not OEM tooling; actual G2b TEC retained

feedthroughs.status: unnumbered nine-instance construction; first two retain G3a positions, added seven on10.8mm PCD; not OEM pinout

hot_mount.status: assumed insulating thermal joint; no asserted solder grade

die_attach.status: assumed insulating epoxy-equivalent; no chemistry claim

mct.source: Heckman/Gonzalez/Guha (2008), original Table2, x=.29; k derived from measured density/Cp/diffusivity
mct.policy: piecewise linear in local nodal T; reject outside90..400 K; no x interpolation; no transient calculation

wires.type: hybrid massless 1D Fourier conductance between area-weighted 3D endpoint patches
wires.status: vendor Au bulk proxy, chosen bond length/diameter; no resolved 3D wire arc, no detector electric current/Joule path

electrical_package_policy: S=0 and computational sigma=1e-12 S/m on non-TEC domains, for a connected passive potential extension. This is not physical Au/Kovar conductivity. Fourier thermal model; bound parasitic current/Joule and test100x lower sigma.
boundaries: 300 K external header underside only; internal cap/window/pins unconstrained. Internal skin has conservative nonlinear radiation/gas and hybrid Au/Cu endpoint powers. Exterior cap/window and isolated pin ends adiabatic.
heating: uniform actual MCT volume source=(one bias-power representation + absorbed optical thermal power)/volume

sources.geometry: geometry/reference_cad.py and revision6 assumptions, visual dimensions rebuilt independently
sources.TEC: protected G2b constant verification properties; no measured wide-T or OEM-grade accuracy

missing: spectral window transmission and external enclosure exchange

cap.status: assumed stainless-steel-like constant thermal proxy; cap roof/side thicknesses not OEM verified

window.status: vendor conductivity proxy; no actual coatings or spectral emissivity/transmission qualification
window.thermal_radiation_policy: opaque diffuse gray hypotheses; do not equate optical transmission with thermal IR absorption

supply_leads.status: two hybrid thermal Cu leads, assumed8mm length/AWG32 diameter; generic warm pin positions, not product pinout; include I^2R split equally at endpoints
supply_leads.source: OEM AWG32 designation inherited; Cu constants protected generic reference

radiation.model: opaque diffuse-gray surface radiosity; cosine first-hit rays on audited closed cavity, reciprocal area balancing
radiation.outer_boundary: cap/window externally adiabatic; thermal bath only at header underside. External thermal IR transmission/exchange omitted, not calibrated.
radiation.optical: 0.5mW thermally absorbed optical load specified in die; not a modeled spectral window transmission calculation

gas.author: Marcia L. Huber
gas.status: dilute limiting k(T); linear interpolation; reject outside200..400K; Huber table generally<3% uncertainty, not calibrated package confidence
gas.viscosity: Eucken closure mu=k/(cp+1.25R), not independent measured viscosity
gas.conductance: Gij=k*Ai*Fij/(normal_projected_harmonic_gap + 2*jump); symmetric positive exchange areas and equal/opposite power; reduced film operator, not gas CFD
gas.vacuum: p=0 gives exactly zero gas exchange; no uncorrected continuum k at zero pressure
gas.regimes: Kn<.01 continuum; .01.. .1 slip; .1..10 transition; >10 free molecular; pair gaps vary, nominal/actual-gap ranges reported
gas.free_molecular_check: independent Kennard coefficient alpha/(2-alpha)*(gamma+1)/(gamma-1)*p*sqrt(R/(8*pi*T)) per unit area

numerical_limits.nonlocal_iteration: depth4 regularized Anderson, same physical fixed point; independent final unaccelerated flux reconstruction

interfaces: Conformal ideal thermal continuity at cap/header flange and window/cap rim; no measured seal/contact resistance. Finite-volume mount and die-attach proxies retain G3a dimensions/k.
